rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact — price is pinned at the low of day below VWAP (13.60) on a risk-off tape, and buyers have repeatedly lifted the 13.58 offer for 15+ minutes without producing a single close above it, with volume drying into a coil at the lows (typical bearish continuation behavior rather than basing). Risk to the 13.61 invalidation is only ~$44 (~12% of the remaining loss budget) against ~$166 to the 13.42 gap-fill target, so there is no evidence-based reason to exit a trade that has not been invalidated; flipping long would require at minimum a reclaim of VWAP, which has not occurred.
